name: Ichinose Sakiko
source:
A married woman who is Azusa's mother and currently follows Ryuusuke, the owner of the secret club “Gentil Donna,” and calls herself his number one supporter.

She is a scary person who mainly supports him financially, and sometimes asks the club members to help her with various backdoor schemes. 

According to Ryuusuke, she is even more of a sexual powerhouse than Azusa when she is in the mood. She is especially fond of young, handsome men. 

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/ks2/about.html]Official website[/url]]
